thread:
maya (prod): FYI customer requested tenant-level pin + console/API control + 9mo TTL. Need quick tradeoff call.
leo (eng): Tenant pin doable. Option A: tenant_pin flag on tenant record. Option B: per-catalog pinned_tenants list. A is simpler.
ina (eng-ml): For acceptance we should require their prompt bundle (>=500 examples) so we can run diff tests. Auto-fallback if quality drop >1.2%.
paul (cs): Customer wants editable pins in console and an audit trail. Also migration credits for longer TTL.
leo (eng): Risks: blocks global rollouts, increases state to honor during routing, requires rate limits on bulk swaps. Estimate: 2 sprints to ship MVP + 1 sprint QA.
maya (prod): Proposed terms to customer: 9mo pin if they provide eval bundle + accept our synthetic canaries in off-hours OR 6mo pin with no canaries. Also offer 2 months migration credit for stricter latency SLAs.
ina (eng-ml): I'll draft the eval hook and threshold. Need customer samples by EOD next week.
paul (cs): I'll surface this to the account team and start negotiating credits/console features.
maya (prod): Action items: @leo spike schema + API, @nina eval hooks, @paul comms. Back to async. :thumbsup:
